They set on this pet just with the inspiration of the words which said "A couple of eyes are waiting for you here, but thousands of eyes are waiting in faraway lands." They had sacrifice and kindness in their bags, love in their hearts and a smiling Selam (greetings) in their tongues.  - Written by Akif Okumus
33122: Jason Chan, a Hong Kong lawyer, is angry at the way the law protects criminals and decides to take the law into his own hands, dishing out vigilante justice when a key witness and his entire family are murdered. Senior Insp. Sandy Jones / Cindy Si

The only way out is to fight.

NOT A GANGSTER PICTURE BUT ...a war on the deadliest public enemy of all!

The Memorable World of Italian Dreams... The Private World of Three Brothers
37730: Raja, son of a vegetable vendor, is a simple man. His girlfriends dump him because of his honesty. However, things take a turn when he meets his true love Priya, the daughter of a police commissioner.

Once it sees your soul, it hunts your flesh.

Eye-Filling Spectacle! Man Against Monsters! The Largest Cast Ever Used in a Motion Picture! A cast of 106,000! 11,000 horses!

Friend zoned for 18 years. Can't we just start dating?

A story about life's strikeouts and home runs.

Who ever thought that making love could be such a glamorous, romantic, spectacular adventure?
Olimpia Capce Latro, Princess of Altamura

They Hired Themselves A Hero - But All They Bought Was Trouble!

The heist of a lifetime just got complicated.

The incredible life... the spectacular thrills... the fabulous times of America's best-loved hero.......

Assassin. Bodyguard. Lover. Is he next on... The Hit List

A New Type of Racket Exposed! In This Thrilling Underworld Drama

There is no end before I avenge my brother.

48994: A student diver risks her scholastic future and relationship with her father when she dates a moody transfer student consumed by their romance.
Lala's First Love is Yudhis' Forever.

La directrice de la maison de retraite

Where there is love, there is life.

Shocking. Beautiful. Brilliant. Sensual. Deadly...and in the end, only they will survive.

You've Entered Cyberzone. Let The Chase Begin.

Now the screen tells what makes a woman - and what breaks her!
